description: Dataset- Greenhouse Gas Emissions of Selected Hydropower Reservoirs in Vietnam Using G-res Tool is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors Surajit Ghosh, De nik De Sarkar (International Water Management Institute). Datasets for the GHG Emissions Estimates of Hydropower Reservoirs in Vietnam Using G-res Tool. In G-res tool, the input parameters can be saved or exported in MER file format. These MER file can be reused to optimize the input datasets to estimate the emissions. Coverage: national (VN); the metadata date the deposit to 2024. Formats: XML. Size stated: 70315. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
